svg.title: lifs-tools/msdeposit workflow overview
svg.desc: Pre-processing (study adapter, input contract, private launch), the Nextflow pipeline with standard and sensitive-data paths and check steps, and post-processing (review, accession, submission, curation, raw data retention).
svg.text: Nextflow pipeline (nf-core template) for MetaboLights deposition, with optional sensitive-data path (DRAFT 3)
• map raw files ↔ samples, fix errors
meta = [id, study, assay, sample, format, vendor, run_index, raw_id] · versions via topic channels
ranges, run metrics, SHA-1, source SHA-1,
deposited names, assay files, MAF names, raw ids, polarity reconciliation;
vendor raw files for deposition; folders →
raw files not deposited · outputs routed to private_outdir
header: serials, sourceFile names/paths, ids, samples, contacts, userParams, timestamps;
body rewrite of ids/titles/userParams (default on; off → study blocked); payloads verified
per study, from plan + metadata + inputs; hashes of the deposited mzML
upload set per study (not yet published)
FILES/RAW_FILES (std.) · DERIVED_FILES · RESULTS · QC · ISA/MAF · upload_manifest.tsv
C6 MetaboLights validation (pinned bundle + OPA, offline)
C1–C5 run in the steps above · blocking or configurable
S1 scanner self-test with planted canary tokens
S2 identifier scan: all files incl. mzML text + file names
S3 residual fields in mzML (serials, paths, contacts …)
S4 no raw files · S5 mapping isolation
S7 run keys / tags / paths free of denylist tokens
exit non-zero if any study is blocked · version summary (topic channels)
sensitive: post-run canary scan of the whole outdir (incl. pipeline_info, reports, captured console)
